description: The Verified Narrative: client- or advisor-ready prose for a stored decision (decision_id) or an inline decision object. A model drafts the narrative FROM the decision; a deterministic gate then extracts every number in the draft and verifies each against the decision's own values — correctly-rounded restatements pass, invented numbers reject the draft whole (one retry, then refusal; a narrative is never patched). The response reports how many claims were checked.
name: narrate_decision
